name: Railcraft Low Pressure Boiler 1x1
notes: Railcraft low-pressure steam boiler (1x1 firebox, Railcraft 9.17.31, the version in GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3). Solid firebox at the base, low-pressure tanks above; no walls (fireboxes and tanks only, per the wiki). It cannot wallshare and must be at least one block from another boiler (minGap 1). One tank layer. Pipes: fluid and item input only at the firebox base; output only into tank blocks. No hatches are modelled.
